# Clear an old restore preview after an invalid backup is selected

## What & Why
If a valid backup opens a restore preview and the user then selects a malformed or invalid backup, the app must not leave the earlier valid workspace available for accidental confirmation. Protect this replacement path with a browser regression test.

## Done looks like
- A valid workspace backup opens the restore dialog
- Selecting an invalid workspace file closes the pending preview
- The app shows the validation error and leaves the current profile, answers, applications, and storage unchanged
- A later valid backup can still open and confirm normally
